{{Quote|Well, I'll be. The insignia for the Free Dac Volunteers Engineering Corps! If that doesn't confirm the battleship was built at Pammant, I don't know what does. We'd better get this to Coruscant immediately.|Clone Captain Lock, during an inspection of the ''Malevolence''{{'s}} wreckage|<ref name="Breakout Squad">''[[The Clone Wars: Secret Missions 1: Breakout Squad]]''</ref>}}
'''Pammant''' was a tunneled [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Calamari sector/Legends|Calamari sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] of nearby [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] staked claims to Pammant and other worlds located in the [[Sector/Legends|sector]], using them as bases for [[Starship/Legends|starship]] construction. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], the [[Pammant Docks/Legends|Pammant shipyards]] were used by the Quarren-dominated [[Free Dac Volunteers Engineering Corps/Legends|Free Dac Volunteers Engineering Corps]] to produce Separatist [[Warship/Legends|warships]] such as the [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']] and the [[Invisible Hand/Legends|''Invisible Hand'']], both used as [[Flagship/Legends|flagships]] by the Separatist [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]. However, before the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Pammant was [[Destruction of Pammant|devastated]] when the Republic [[Praetor-class Star Battlecruiser/Legends|''Praetor''-class Star Battlecruiser]] ''[[Quaestor]]'' suffered a [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] accident and collided with the planet, fracturing Pammant and dousing it with [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]].

==Description==
The tunneled<ref name="ICS" /> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] Pammant was located in the [[Pammant system/Legends|Pammant system]]<ref name="Atlas" /> in the [[Calamari sector/Legends|Calamari sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="Atlas Online Companion" /> It was situated on the [[Prously's Rim Run]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]], which connected Pammant to two nearby planets—[[Dac/Legends|Dac]] in the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] northwest and [[Mantan]] in the galactic south. Though originally an uninhabited world, Pammant was one of several planets in the Calamari [[Sector/Legends|sector]] claimed by the aquatic [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]], who used their new worlds as locations for [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Shipyard/Legends|construction yards]].<ref name="Atlas" />

==History==
[[File:QuarrenNEGAS.jpg|thumb|left|150px|A Quarren, whose species colonized Pammant]]
At some point before [[4166 BBY]], the uninhabited world of Pammant was one of many planets, including [[Minntooine/Legends|Minntooine]] and [[Buchich]], claimed by the Quarren in the Calamari sector. The Quarren used their new acquisitions as locations for shipyards.<ref name="Atlas" /> By the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] thousands of years later, Pammant housed both a Quarren colony and the [[Pammant Docks/Legends|premier shipyards]],<ref name="Strongholds" /> a facility located in the underground tunnels of the world.<ref name="ICS" />

After the Clone Wars [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|erupted]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the [[Quarren Isolation League/Legends|Quarren Isolation League]] formed and allied itself with the Confederacy, causing the Quarren-dominated worlds in the Calamari sector to follow suit. On both Pammant and Minntooine, the Quarren of the [[Free Dac Volunteers Engineering Corps/Legends|Free Dac Volunteers Engineering Corps]] produced a variety of [[Warship/Legends|warships]] for use in the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Confederate Navy]].<ref name="Atlas" /> Pammant's docks became highly valued by the Confederacy. The shipyards produced [[Providence-class carrier/destroyer/Legends|''Providence''-class carrier/destroyers]] such as the [[Invisible Hand/Legends|''Invisible Hand'']], the ''[[Colicoid Swarm]]'', and the [[Lucid Voice/Legends|''Lucid Voice'']],<ref name="Episode Guide">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars – The Official Episode Guide: Season 1]]''</ref> each of which was used by the Separatist [[Supreme Commander of the Droid Armies/Legends|Supreme Commander]], [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], to spread fear throughout the Republic.<ref name="ICS" />

Additionally, the [[Subjugator-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Subjugator''-class heavy cruiser]] line was designed and manufactured on Pammant, a fact shrouded in secrecy by the Quarren Separatists, who used the construction of the ''Providence''-class [[Carrier/Legends|carrier]]/[[Destroyer/Legends|destroyers]] as their cover.<ref name="TCWCG">''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref> During the construction of the heavy [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']], Republic [[Spy/Legends|spies]] watching Pammant observed the immense [[Drydock/Legends|drydock]] in which the warship was being constructed. When the ship was finally launched, the operatives were captured before they could report their sighting of the massive ship to the Republic government on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. A few weeks later, the ''Malevolence''{{'s}} sister ship, the ''[[Devastation]]'', was launched from Pammant.<ref name="Episode Guide" /> Following the ''Malevolence''{{'s}} [[Battle of the Kaliida Nebula/Legends|destruction]], [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Lock (clone trooper)|Lock]] led a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] team to search through the cruiser's debris. They found evidence that the warship had been constructed by the Free Dac Volunteers Engineering Corps at Pammant, confirming beliefs held by [[Republic Intelligence/Legends|Republic Intelligence]].<ref name="Breakout Squad" /> The Confederacy also investigated the ''Malevolence''{{'s}} crash site, but for a different purpose, retrieving intelligence for use in the construction of a [[Malevolence (II)|new ''Malevolence'']] at Pammant. Grievous personally oversaw the effort, journeying to Pammant alongside Separatist [[Head of State/Legends|leader]] [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]. They were [[Mission to Pammant|pursued]] by a [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Clone Wars)|Jedi Knight]], who engaged them in a duel on the planet.<ref name="CC">{{TCWA|Card Commander}}</ref>

Just before the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="ICS" /> the Republic [[Praetor-class Star Battlecruiser/Legends|''Praetor''-class Star Battlecruiser]] ''[[Quaestor]]'' led a Republic [[Destruction of Pammant|attack]] on Pammant. During the battle, [[torpedo droid]]s damaged the [[Battlecruiser/Legends|battlecruiser's]] [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]], causing the ship to jump to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] and collide with the planet.<ref name="EGW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> The cataclysm destroyed the ''Quaestor'' and devastated Pammant,<ref name="CSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> which was fractured to the core.<ref name="ICS" /> All life on Pammant was annihilated, though the shipyards remained intact. Lethal doses of [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]] penetrated inadequate shielding and flash-fried all the workers. The ring of shipyards still stands, a radioactive monument to the sudden death of billions.<ref name="Strongholds" />

==Inhabitants==
Though originally uninhabited, Pammant was claimed by the Quarren,<ref name="Atlas" /> who established a colony on the planet.<ref name="ICS" /> By the final decade of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], Pammant was home to billions of [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] inhabitants.<ref name="Strongholds" /> They allied themselves with the Confederacy during the Clone Wars, using their factories to strengthen the Separatist war machine.<ref name="Atlas" />

==Locations==
[[File:Malevolence_profile.png|thumb|250px|The ''Malevolence'', a Separatist warship manufactured at Pammant]]
Pammant was a tunneled world home to the underground shipbuilding factories of the Pammant Docks and the Free Dac Volunteers Engineering Corps. The factories were used to produce Separatist warships during the Clone Wars, such as the ''Invisible Hand''<ref name="ICS" /> and the ''Malevolence''.<ref name="TCWVG">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: The Visual Guide]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Quarren colony world of Pammant first received a brief mention in [[2005]]'s ''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith Incredible Cross-Sections]]'' as the location of the ''Invisible Hand''{{'s}} construction. Since then, the world has appeared in additional sources, each of which contributed minor details to Pammant's history. ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: The Visual Guide]]'', published in [[2008]], established Pammant as the origin of the ''Malevolence'' from [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'' TV series]], and [[2009]]'s ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' provided both the galactic location for Pammant and a brief history of the world.
